repos_data.description: Open-source (AGPL-3.0) PDF takeoff for construction & flooring — the first engine an AI agent drives natively over MCP, not bolted on. Rooms measured on the wall faces, symbol sweeps, materials + quantities with full provenance, built for preconstruction. Runs entirely in your browser.
Talk to live Autodesk Revit models from Claude, Cursor or any MCP client. One undo per change, read-only switch, MSI and Intune ready, Revit 2022-2027.
AEC 전문 지식 큐레이팅 시스템. AI 에이전트에 한국 건설기준·법령·실무 지식을 출처와 함께 제공합니다. AEC Expert Knowledge Curation System. Korean building codes, statutes and practice, with sources.
